flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Senior Director, Head of Computational Sciences
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: About Tilde (FL110) Tilde Bio, Inc. (FL110) is building a next-generation biological sensing platform at the intersection of synthetic biology, protein engineering, nanopore biophysics, electrophysiology, signal processing, and machine learning. Our goal is to create programmable biological measurement systems capable of extracting rich molecular information from single-molecule interactions. We believe nanopores generate a high-dimensional measurement of molecular identity and behavior that remains largely untapped. Unlocking that information requires new computational approaches — ones that don't yet exist — built by people who are comfortable working at the edge of what's known. At Tilde, you will work alongside scientists and engineers from diverse disciplines to help define how a new generation of biological sensing systems extract meaning from the physical world. Tilde is backed by Flagship Pioneering, which brings the long-term vision and resources needed to build platforms that don't fit neatly into existing categories. Position Summary We are looking for a visionary, hands-on computational leader to build-out and lead Tilde's computational sciences. This person will own the algorithms, models, and data infrastructure that sit at the heart of our nanopore-based protein reading platform — from raw signal processing through to protein identification and quantification. The role is cross-functional by design. You will be embedded in the science, working directly with nanopore scientists, protein engineers, and the technology development team to turn experimental data into platform insight. At the same time, you will be building a team and shaping a longer-term computational roadmap. The right candidate has strong technical depth in machine learning and computational biology, has led teams before, and is comfortable operating in an environment where the science is still being defined. Key Responsibilities Computational Strategy & Platform Vision Set the computational sciences strategy and roadmap, working with the leadership team to align priorities with where the platform needs to go. Build the computational sciences team — recruiting, mentoring, and creating an environment where scientists do their best work and remain current on latest developments in their field. Computational Sciences Research Lead development of algorithms and models for processing, decoding, and interpreting signals from Tilde's nanopore-based protein reading platform. Work closely with nanopore scientists and hardware engineers to advance a fast-evolving analytical framework. Design and implement ML pipelines for protein identification, classification, and quantification, drawing on multi-modal datasets spanning proteomic, genomic, and platform-generated data. Establish data management practices, versioning standards, and analytical SOPs that support reproducible, scalable science, including creating and maintenance of cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS) that can handle platform-scale data generation. Leadership Partner with research, molecular engineering, data science, and technology development — making sure computational capabilities stay integrated with what the experimental teams need. Work with program leads on data generation strategies, experimental designs, and analysis frameworks. Work with external collaborators or consultants, as needed, to accelerate our research productivity. Identify and protect novel computational methods as part of Tilde's IP strategy. Communicate technical progress clearly to leadership and, where relevant, to external partners and investors. Qualifications Required PhD in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field. 10+ years of experience in computational biology or a closely related area, with at least 4 years leading a team. Track record of building and developing strong computational teams across different organizations. Strong hands-on ML and programming skills

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2cfb1634-412d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Functional and Automated Tester based in the United States. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on delivering secure, reliable, and high-performing modern applications. You will lead functional and automated testing across complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments. The role combines hands-on automation with test strategy, release readiness, defect prevention, and quality governance. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, DevSecOps, and business stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle. Your work will span APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and user-facing applications. You’ll also help strengthen observability, security, performance, and operational readiness across delivery teams. This remote opportunity is suited to a technically strong tester who enjoys solving complex problems and raising engineering quality standards. Lead testing strategy and planning by defining scope, risks, environments, test data, tooling, timelines, and release-readiness requirements. Translate business and technical requirements into comprehensive test strategies, test plans, test cases, and validation approaches covering functional, integration, regression, performance, and security needs. Design, develop, and maintain automated tests for unit, API, integration, and user-interface testing, integrating repeatable automation into CI/CD pipelines. Execute hands-on functional testing across workflows, edge cases, data validation, error handling, and operational scenarios to ensure solutions meet business and user expectations. Validate distributed and event-driven architectures, including asynchronous workflows and message-based services such as Kafka, with emphasis on resiliency, traceability, and correct processing. Test API-centric architectures, including microservices and serverless applications, validating contracts, backward compatibility, integrations, and end-to-end behavior. Partner with DevSecOps and engineering teams to promote secure development practices, consistent standards, and effective quality controls. Coordinate test environments, deployments, configuration changes, and environment readiness with technical teams. Identify security and data risks during testing, document findings, escalate issues appropriately, and track defects through resolution. Lead defect triage and root-cause analysis, collaborate with developers and stakeholders to verify fixes, and introduce preventative quality measures. Validate observability practices, including logging, metrics, tracing, performance baselines, and operational readiness. Produce clear test evidence, defect reports, dashboards, diagrams, and runbooks suitable for leadership, operational, audit, and compliance needs. Apply approved AI-assisted development and testing tools to accelerate test creation, analysis, and defect triage while maintaining security and quality standards. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; candidates without a relevant four-year degree may qualify with an additional four years of relevant experience. At least 8 years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, or software development with substantial testing and automation responsibilities. Proven experience owning test strategy and automation for complex, distributed, cloud-based, or enterprise applications. Strong functional testing and automation experience across the software development lifecycle, including regression planning and release readiness. Hands-on experience with automated testing for unit, API, integration, and user-interface layers, with familiarity with TDD and automation-first approaches. Experience working within CI/CD environments using source-control and build/deployment technol

Strong organizational skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to balance competing priorities. A proactive, relationship-oriented mindset with a strong focus on long-term customer success. southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:a7.description: WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS. We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. ABOUT THE ROLE We're growing fast and bringing in world-class talent from around the globe, and we're doing it differently than most. That kind of momentum doesn't run itself. We're hiring someone to build the engine behind it: the HR processes, playbooks, and systems that can scale as fast as we do. This is a rare chance to own real scope early. You'll help build and run our core HR functions from the ground up, including onboarding, benefits, compensation, compliance, and employee relations. You'll also own our immigration program end to end. Along the way you'll solve hard problems, work cases that actually matter to people's lives, and watch the things you build become how the company runs. In this role you will: - Own and evolve our People systems and operational infrastructure, ensuring our HR technology, data, workflows, and integrations are accurate, scalable, and effective as Cognition grows. - Design the systems that make People Operations scalable, including tracking, playbooks, checklists, documentation, and clear ownership so that nothing falls through the cracks. - Lead benefits operations and administration, partnering with brokers, vendors, payroll, Finance, and employees to deliver a high-quality benefits experience in the US and support our evolving international benefits programs. - Build and manage our compliance infrastructure, translating employment requirements into practical processes and controls across an increasingly complex, multi-state and international workforce. - Develop and maintain employee policies and our handbook, balancing compliance requirements with Cognition’s culture and operating philosophy. - Bring an operational lens to business decisions, surfacing risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early and helping leaders navigate complex People situations with strong judgment. - Partner closely with Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT, Recruiting, and external vendors to ensure People programs are executed accurately and seamlessly. - Use data and operational insights to identify issues and improve programs, building reporting, controls, and processes that allow the team to operate proactively rather than reactively. - Jump into high-priority People and business projects as needed. We are a lean team operating in a rapidly evolving company, so the scope of this role will continue to expand alongside Cognition. Requirements for this role: - 7+ years in people operations or HR at a fast-growing startup or tech company - Strong end-to-end People Operations experience, with the ability to own and scale programs across areas such as benefits, immigration, compliance, systems, and employee operations. - Experience in a fast-growing startup or technology company, with comfort operating in a high-velocity environment where priorities evolve quickly and processes are still being built. - Strong first-principles thinking and a can-do attitude — you can break down ambiguous problems, challenge existing assumptions, and figure out practical solutions without waiting for a playbook. - Strong data-driven, analytical, and program management skills, with the ability to use data to inform decisions, manage complex cross-functional initiatives, and drive work from idea through execution.
